query: SELECT character.id AS character_id, character.name AS character_name, character.description AS character_description, character.sheet, location.id AS location_id, location.name AS location_name, location.description AS location_description FROM world_member AS member JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = member.id JOIN character ON character.id = player_character.character_id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = character.id JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id JOIN location ON location.id = "group".location_id WHERE member.id = ? AND member.world_id = ? AND member.user_id = ? AND player_character.character_id = ? AND member.access = 'active'
